text:
ellie_sales: Urgent: QuantaHealth POC is blocked by signature routing. They have two contracting entities and DocuSign keeps failing the second signer (role/email mismatch). Customer needs Net45 and EU HSM key addendum. Can we do a fast temporary hookup so infra can start this week?

esign-bot: system: envelope validation failed (ROLE_EMAIL_MISMATCH)
```
Template role 'EntityB' expected 'partner@quanta.eu' got 'partner+qa@quanta.eu'
POST /v2/envelopes/validate
```
ellie_sales: @tom_procure @viv_legal any quick workaround? :pray:

tom_procure: Two viable fast paths: 1) accept a PO from primary entity + a one-page consent from secondary entity (email ok) so finance can create invoice and start Net45 provisioning; 2) split into two envelopes (one per entity) and reference both envelope IDs on the invoice. Either is fine but accounting needs clear refs.

viv_legal: For POC we prefer minimal friction. I can draft a one-paragraph consent that references the OrderForm and PO#, limited to POC scope. I'll also prepare a short EU HSM addendum (customer-managed keys). ETA 8 hours. If DocuSign keeps failing, two-envelope approach is legally OK provided orderform cross-ref language present.

ash_eng: From infra: we can provision a scoped sub-account and issue time-limited API keys so they can run the POC immediately. Requirements: 1) written PO or email ack of POC terms, 2) contact email for billing, 3) confirmation of HSM usage (yes/no) so we can enable key config. This removes the blocker for dev/testing.

maya_billing: HSM surcharge note: EU HSM = +15% on the dedicated key line. Invoice needs a separate line: "EU HSM (monthly)" with amount and must reference either both envelope IDs or both PO numbers to combine into one invoice. If we only have primary PO we can still invoice but must note the secondary consent reference.

ellie_sales: I'll ask Quanta for the PO and the exact signer emails now. Viv please send the consent + HSM draft to procurement@quantahealth.com and cc billing@redwood.com. Ash please stand by to create the sub-account if we get the PO.

viv_legal: Draft consent snippet I'll use: "Entity B hereby consents to the OrderForm executed by Entity A for the limited POC described herein. This consent applies only to POC provisioning and does not constitute a waiver of any future contracting requirements." Will include narrow HSM clause: jurisdiction EU, customer-managed keys, rotation per schedule.

ash_eng: CLI helper if you need to resend envelope with explicit role mapping:
```
docusign-cli envelopes resend --template-id tpl_quanta_v2 \
  --roles '[{"roleName":"EntityA_Signer","email":"ceo@quantahealth.com"},{"roleName":"EntityB_Signer","email":"partner@quanta.eu"}]' --force-validate
```
That usually resolves the '+' alias issue.

tom_procure: If they provide two POs, accounting can merge into one invoice referencing both. If only one PO, include envelope ID and the consent email text. I'll monitor PO and ping AE after 36h if nothing.

ellie_sales: Customer replied: "We can send PO today; secondary signer will use partner+qa alias for now." Sending PO request now and asking if they can sign the consent email in reply.

maya_billing: Once PO arrives include billing contact, remit address, and GL code if available. I'll prepare an invoice template showing the HSM line so sales can screenshot it to the customer.

viv_legal: Sending drafts now to procurement@quantahealth.com (consent + HSM addendum). Please ask them to reply to the consent email with the secondary signer's acknowledgement if DocuSign still fails.

ash_eng: Standing by. If PO comes in I'll provision sub-account and enable HSM flag (if requested). We can start POC infra within 24 hours of PO confirmation.

ellie_sales: Plan: 1) get PO + billing contact from Quanta (I'm on it), 2) Viv sends consent & HSM addendum draft (sent), 3) Ash provisions sub-account once PO confirmed, 4) Tom/maya will process invoice/Net45. Target: POC up by EOW.

esign-bot: note: if resending envelopes, prefer exact emails (no plus aliases) to avoid template role validation.

tom_procure: I'll escalate to AE if PO not received in 48h. Tracking assigned.

ellie_sales: Thanks everyone — updating customer and will post PO when received. :rocket:
